description: This file defines an interface abstract class 'IController' with various virtual methods related to device or system control, such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, Environment, Configuration, and Clone. It appears to be part of a plugin system within the WPEFramework project, and it uses IPC or RPC mechanisms, as suggested by the ID macro and the method signatures.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controller operations, providing methods for persisting state, deleting paths, rebooting, retrieving environment and configuration, and cloning callsigns.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persist the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a resource identified by the specified path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieve the environment details associated with the specified index.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieve the configuration for the given callsign or set configuration for the callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a new callsign by cloning an existing one.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
